The Luminous Crafting Table is the first tier of crafting altar and is used throughout the Exploration chapter of the Astral Tome.

The Table will gather Starlight when exposed to the sky. This amount increases as it approaches midnight and the higher up it is placed, with the maximum efficiency being when placed at a Y-level above 127.

Right-clicking it will open its UI where items can be placed, just like in a Crafting Table. When a valid recipe is created the output item appears on the right-hand side. However, the crafting output cannot be directly picked up; instead, the Table must be right-clicked with a Resonating Wand when enough Starlight is currently gathered in the Table, consuming the inputs and dropping the output above it after a few seconds.

§T§bTo craft this luminous crafting table you will have to go into the mining world and place your crafting table nearby the Collector Crystal that you can find in the big astral structure.

The Starlight Crafting Altar is the second tier of crafting altar and is used throughout the Attunement chapter of the Astral Tome.

The Altar works similarly to its predecessor the Luminous Crafting Table, and can make all recipes that the latter can. However, it has 4 extra input slots that can be used for more crafting recipes, and gather Starlight much more efficiently, but requires a complete structure to be built around it in order to do so.

The Celestial Altar is the third tier of crafting altar and is used throughout the Constellation chapter of the Astral Tome.

The Altar works similarly to its predecessor the Starlight Crafting Altar, and can make all recipes that the latter can. However, it has 8 extra input slots that can be used for more crafting recipes, can gather Starlight much more efficiently, and requires a larger structure to be built in order to support it.

The Iridescent Altar is the fourth and last tier of crafting altar and is used throughout the Radiance chapter of the Astral Tome. It can contain more Starlight and adds 4 more slots for crafting.

The Altar works similarly to its predecessor the Starlight Crafting Altar, and can make all recipes that the latter can. However, it has 4 extra input slots that can be used for more crafting recipes and 1 input to the left to put a constellation-attuned Rock Crystals or Celestial Crystals for certain recipes, can gather Starlight much more efficiently, and requires pretty the same structure, look your Astar Tome to see it.

The Spectral Relay can either be used to bring more starlight to a Luminous Crafting Table (or any upgrade), to set the target Constellation of an Attunement Altar, or to provide items for an Iridescent Altar. They can hold a single item.

When placed in a multiblock structure (shown in your Altar Tome) with a clear view of the sky and a Glass Lens put into it, the Spectral Relay will bring more starlight to the closest Luminous Crafting Table (or any upgrade) in a 16 blocks radius around itself. Multiple Relays in a 16 block radius will have diminishing effects.

When placed around an Iridescent Altar on the sooty marble, Relays will be highlighted during crafting, showing an image of an item to place on them to continue crafting.
The Resonating Wand is used to activate Astral Sorcery's crafting altars, as well as the Starlight Infuser.

The Mantle of Stars is slightly worse than a Diamond Chestplate, but with far better enchantability, it can be attuned to one of the constellations to provide additional effects.

§7Aevitas | The Mantle will regenerate the player's hunger bar and health while it is worn.
§rArmara | This constellation will completely block an attack inflicted upon the player. By default the Mantle can block 3 attacks and recharge one stack every 80 ticks (or 4 seconds). This can be changed in the mod's config file.
§7Bootes | When attacked, there is a chance of a Flare being spawned near the player and assisting them in combat.
§rDiscidia | When damaged while wearing the Mantle, the player stores damage taken and releases it when landing a hit on an entity.
§7Evorsio | This constellation will cause the player to break blocks faster and deals significant damage to nearby hostile mobs when one is slain.
§rFornax | When worn, the Mantle converts fire damage into healing. It will also melt or burn the block the player is standing on.
§7Horologium | Being attacked causes nearby entities to freeze momentarily. There is a cooldown period before it can freeze entities again. Fire damage will not bring about this effect.
§rLucerna | Hostile mobs will emit light particles revealing their locations.
§7Mineralis | When holding a block in hand, the player is able to see outlines of the identical block in the world.
§rOctans | The Mantle provides the player with infinite Water Breathing.
§7Pelotrio | When worn the Mantle creates the appropriate tool to break the block or attack a mob in front of the player.
§rVicio | When worn, the Mantle allows the wearer to glide as if using an Elytra.

The Blood Altar is used to transmute various items using Life Essence (LP).

It has an internal storage buffer of 1,000 LP that must be filled before crafting can occur.

The altar can be expanded into a multiblock structure in order to access more powerful tiers of transmutation.

To see the structure you need to build to get the next tiers of your blood altar, check out the Inspectoris Scandalum.

The Inspectoris Scandalum show you how to build the multiblock structure to get next tier from your blood altar.

When you have it in hand, simply right click to select the tier you want and then shift right click on your blood altar to show you a hologram of the selected tier you want.

The Sacrificial Dagger is used as a self-sacrifice method, allowing the user to convert their health points into usable Life Essence.

To take health from other creatures in return for LP, sacrifice methods such as the Dagger of Sacrifice must be used.

The Dagger of Sacrifice is used to sacrifice creatures for Life Essence.
The amount varies per creature, and can be further increased through the use of Runes of Sacrifice.

Villager give you the most LP than other mobs.
The Arcane Ashes is used to create the Alchemy Array, which is needed for the new way to create the sigils of Blood Magic.

While holding the Divination Sigil, there are two possible uses for us.
When aiming at a Blood Altar and right clicking, a chat printout will display the total essence stored within the altar, the current tier, and its maximum capacity.
When right clicking anywhere else, a chat printout will display the total essence stored in our "Blood Network".

Use a Binding Reagent with a Diamond Sword on Arcane Ashes to get a Bound Blade.
This Bound Blade use LP from your "blood network".

The Blank Rune is used in upgrading the tier of the Blood Altar and crafting other runes.

The Speed Rune does what its name implies, and provides an additive 20% increase to the processing speed of the Blood Altar.

The Rune of Sacrifice will increase the total amount of LP gained by sacrificing mobs with a Dagger of Sacrifice by an additive 10%.

The Rune of Sacrifice will increase the total amount of LP gained by using a Sacrificial Dagger by an additive 10%.

The Rune of Capacity adds an additional 2,000 LP storage potential to the Blood Altar.
This also increases the tank's internal buffer as it is always 10% of the altar's capacity.

The Rune of Displacement increases the speed by which LP can be pumped into and out of the Blood Altar at a multiplicative 20% rate.

The Rune of Augmented Capacity adds 10% extra LP. Each 10% bonus is multiplied on top of the current capacity (not including the Rune of Capacity bonuses, which are added afterwards). 
§oRunes of Capacity are more efficient, although with 15 Augmented Capacity runes the player will surpass the amount gained from the base runes. This also increases the tank's internal buffer as it is always 10% of the altar's capacity
§r
The Rune of the Orb adds an additional 2% capacity per rune to blood orb storage potentia

The Rune of Acceleration decreases the number of processing ticks for displacement and charging rune.
So, the maximum of Rune of Acceleration you can use is 19, because 1 second = 20 ticks.

The Charging Rune add an internal buffer that you can see with a Seer's Sigil.
This internal buffer is a charge of LP.
When you transmute something on your altar with some of these runes the charge came instantly into the item to speed up the transmute process.

The Demon Crystallizer is used for growing Will Crystals Clusters by draining the chunk's Aura, created in a Demon Crucible.
Each Crystal Cluster can have 7 crystals maximum.

Right clicking with a Tartaric Gem or Demonic Will Crystal will insert it into the Demon Crucible and transfer the will of the source into aura stored inside the chunk. Each chunk can hold 100 Will at a time and will type is preserved.

The will in the aura can be used to grow Will Crystals inside a Demon Crystallizer or Will Crystal Clusters.
The Demon Will Crystal can be acquired from a Demon Will Crystal Cluster provided you have Will in the aura.

The Weak Activation Crystal is an activator for your Ritual.
If your ritual is correctly build (use a Ritual Diviner to make sure)
Just right click on a Master Infusion Stone and make sure you have enough Life Essence to activate your ritual and keep it !

The amount of Life Essence consumed is determined by which ritual is activated.

The Awakened Activation Crystal work exactly like the Weak version but it can activate more powerful ritual.

Once again, make sure to have enough Life Essence to run it and keep it.

The Weak Blood Orb is a Life Essence storage.

It converts the Life Essence contained within an altar into a stored form of energy for various rituals.
You can transmute your health point into Life Essence into your "blood network" by right clicking the orb.

This stored Essence cannot be turned back into a physical liquid, and will be stored to your "blood network".

The Weak Blood Orb is capable of storing up to 5,000 LP.
This number can only be raised by using higher tier orbs, or by placing the Rune of the Orb around the Blood Altar.

You need a Tier 1 Altar and 2000 LP to transmute a diamond into a Weak Blood Orb.

The Apprentice Blood Orb is an upgrade from the Weak Blood Orb.

It's capable of storing up to 25,000 LP.
This number can only be raised by using higher tier orbs, or by placing the Rune of the Orb around the Blood Altar.

You need a Tier 2 Altar and 5000 LP to transmute a Redstone Block into an Apprentice Blood Orb.

The Magician Blood Orb is an upgrade from the Apprentice Blood Orb.

It's capable of storing up to 150,000 LP.
This number can only be raised by using higher tier orbs, or by placing the Rune of the Orb around the Blood Altar.

You need a Tier 3 Altar and 25000 LP to transmute a Gold Block into a Magician Blood Orb.

The Master Blood Orb is an upgrade from the Magician Blood Orb.

It's capable of storing up to 1,000,000 LP.
This number can only be raised by using higher tier orbs, or by placing the Rune of the Orb around the Blood Altar.

You need a Tier 4 Altar and 40000 LP to transmute a Weak Blood Shard into a Master Blood Orb.

The Archmage Blood Orb is an upgrade from the Master Blood Orb.

It's capable of storing up to 10,000,000 LP.
This number can only be raised by using higher tier orbs, or by placing the Rune of the Orb around the Blood Altar.

You need a Tier 5 Altar and 80000 LP to transmute a Nether Star into an Archmage Blood Orb.

The Draconic Core is an important crafting ingredient, It's used in many recipes and it is also used to stabilize a mob spawner into a Stabilized Mob Spawner.
The Wyvern Core is the advanced version of a Draconic Core. It is used in higher crafting recipes like all the Wyvern Tools and armor.

The Awakened Core is the third tier of cores. It's mainly used for crafting Draconic Armor and tools.
It is crafted with the Fusion crafting process.

The Chaotic Core is the fourth and final tier core. It's used to craft the Reactor Stabilizer and in the upgrading of tools and armor to Chaotic tier.
In order to craft a Chaotic Core, you need to get a Chaos Shard, which means you need to go to a Chaos Islands and defeat a Chaos Guardians.
It is crafted with the Fusion crafting process.

The Chaos Shard is obtained when a Chaos Crystal is broken. That means you need to visit a Chaos Island and defeat the Chaos Guardian in order to obtain it.

Tip: You can farm those with Woot.

The Awakened Draconium Block is used to craft the Draconic set, Awakened Core and many strong tools and armor. It's wither proof.
You have to kill the Ender Dragon to get this heart in order to make those blocks.
Or you can obtain those by breeding chicken as your choice.

The Energy Core Stabilizer is used to store energy when used in conjunction with a Draconic or Wyvern Energy Core.
This item is also a component of the Energy Core (Draconic Evolution) multiblock.

The Energy Core is the central part of the Energy Core multiblock which can store massive amounts of RF.
This structure comes in 8 tiers.

When fully assembled, RF can be introduced to and extracted from the structure through the use of Energy Pylons.

The Energy Pylon is used to transport energy in and out of Energy Cores.
A block of Glass must be placed on top, or bellow, of it to make it properly function.
The direction of energy can be observed by the particle effects of the translucent sphere.
If they are moving inwards then it will take energy out of an Energy Core, while energy will move into the Energy Core if particle effects are moving outwards.

The Wyvern Armor do not provide you Creative Flight but grant you a great protection if you have a lot of energy.
You can upgrade it by using upgrade key, check the upgrade quests to see it.

The Draconic Armor do provide you creative flight ! It's a mega armor who can protect you from almost any possibility of death, also a nuclear explosion !
Obviously /kill can kill you, unlike the Avaritia armor...
You can upgrade it by using upgrade key, check the upgrade quests to see it.

§oBe careful, when you go to craft this armor it is possible that you do not see the animation in the fusion crafting Core but the craft works well!

The Advanced Dislocator is a teleportation device. Its the enhanced version of the Dislocator.
It can store up to 100 different waypoints, which can additionally be used across dimensions. It uses Ender Pearls as fuel.
The Crystal Binder is used when linking Energy I/O Crystal.

The Wyvern Flux Capacitor is a portable battery.
When shift-right-clicked, it will toggle through 4 modes: Charge Hotbar, Charge Armor & Held Item, Charge Armor & Hotbar and Inactive.
It can store up to 64 million RF which can be upgraded in an Upgrade Modifier.

It can store up to 256 million RF which can be upgraded in an Upgrade Modifier.

The Upgrade Key (Attack Damage) increases the damage done by Draconic Evolution melee weapons.

It uses RF to recharge and use and can store up to 30 million RF.
You can upgrade it to become even more powerful !

The Stabilized Mob Spawner is obtained by right-clicking a vanilla mob spawner with a Draconic Core, Wyvern Core, Awakened Core or Chaotic Core.
Or by crafting a broken spawner with any Core.

When harvested, a Stabilized Mob Spawner will lose the information on the type of mob to spawn and must be "programmed" with a Mob Soul.
Mob Souls are a rare drop when killing a mob using a Draconic Evolution weapon. The percentage chance of a Mob Soul drop can be increased with the Reaper enchantment.

The tier of a Stabilized Mob Spawner is determined by the Core used.
Right-clicking a Stabilized Mob Spawner with a different kind of core will apply the new Core and release the old Core.

§r§dWyvern Core - Spawns up to 6 mobs every 5-20 seconds. Player is not required but all normal spawning requirements must be met.
§r§6Awakened Core - Spawns up to 8 mobs every 2.5-10 seconds. No other requirements.

The Dischantment Generator burns Enchanted Books to generate Redstone Flux (RF) at a rate of 40 per tick.

The Furnace Generator burns solid Furnace fuels to produce Redstone Flux (RF).
The generator outputs 40 RF/t regardless of the fuel used.

The Frosty Generator consumes various types of Ice and Snow to produce Redstone Flux.
The burn rate and power output vary depending on the item.

The Culinary Generator produces Redstone Flux (RF) from food.
The amount of RF it produces depends on the food.
Foods with high saturation and food values produce more RF/t.

The Magmatic Generator consumes Lava at a rate of 1,000 mB every 125 seconds, which produces 100,000 Redstone Flux (RF) per bucket.
The generator has an internal tank of 4,000 mB.

The Halitosis Generator burns Dragon's Breath to produce Redstone Flux (RF).
It will burn 1 bottle over the course of 10 minutes to produce a total of 480,000 RF.
It outputs energy at 40 RF/tick.
The Ender Generator burns Ender Pearls and Eyes of Ender to produce Redstone Flux (RF).

The Death Generator, previously known as the Undeath Generator, burn Bones, Bone Blocks, Rotten Flesh and Wither Skeleton Skulls to generate Redstone Flux (RF) at 20 RF/t.
When generating, however, it will create red particles around the block, and if a player enters the the 3x3 area around the block they will inflict Doom, which will kill them after 60 seconds.

The Survival Generator consumes Furnace fuels to generate 5 Redstone Flux per tick (RF/t).

The Explosive Generator burns either Gunpowder or TNT in order to produce Redstone Flux (RF).

It functions similarly to the Looking Glass; right-clicking the placed block at night will show a view of the night sky's stars, among which the stars of constellations stand out.

Searching and drawing out the constellations works just like the looking glass.

The Evershifting Fountain is the core of an advanced multi-block.
A Chalice must be placed on top of the fountain and supplied with Liquid Starlight for the structure to operate.
Its exact function is determined by the Prime attached to the fountain's bottom side.

You have to make a complete structure to make it work, look at the Astral Tome to see how to do it!

The Necromantic Prime, when placed on the bottom of your Evershifting Fountain will start the Fountain.
When the Fountain starts, it will dig below it to bedrock and mine up any blocks in the way.
These blocks will be dropped around the Fountain.
The Fountain will continue to fill up surrounding Chalices with either water or lava until the Starlight has run out of the Chalice on top of the Fountain. Once the Lava or Water “pool” has been exhausted the fountain will stop and you will need to move the entire structure in order to start the whole process again.

It can be crafted from a Celestial Crystal that is attuned to any of the twelve bright or dim Constellations.

A solid-fuel fission reactor consists of a controller and a reactor core.
The core is then filled with your choice of Reactor Cells, Coolers and Moderator blocks (list below).
Building the frame of the core is simple, but choosing the right combination and configuration of parts to go inside is tricky!

The interior of the reactor core may have any size from 1x1x1 to 24x24x24. Any cuboid shape is valid; it doesn't need to be a cube.

Note that only the faces consist of reactor casing blocks - placing reactor casing along the edges will most often result in the controller being unable to determine the position and size of the reactor.

The Fission Controller must be place alongside or within one of the walls of the frame.
To kick off your Fission reactor, use a redstone signal.

Once these goals are met, a space station can be built. At the start of the build process, the station chip and the Satellite Bay are consumed. At the end of the build process, the structure on the pad is placed into a new station item that is placed in the bottom left slot and a station chip programmed with the coordinates of the new space station's orbit is placed in the bottom right slot.

The base of the construction pads is made from Launch Pad Blocks.
It can be any size between 3x3 and 16x16. The base does not have be a square, rectangular shapes work too.
The height of the structure is defined by the Structure Tower Blocks and can be anywhere between 4 and 64 blocks tall.
If multiple structure towers exist in the structure, then the height of the tallest tower is used.
The base of the tower must be at the same level as the rocket pad.
The base of the tower also has to be touching the pad on one of the four faces and cannot be placed diagonally.
The Rocket Assembling machine must be one block above the pad with the back of the machine facing the pad for the Strcuture to form.
Larger construction pads require more time to scan and build the rocket!

A rocket can be built from any block in the game but must contain a number of Engines and Fuel Tanks. Engines provide thrust, and the number of engines needed is based on the mass. They also consume fuel, which is stored in the fuel tanks. There must be enough fuel tanks to hold the amount of fuel needed for any mission.

Every block you put on your rocket has a mass and more mass requires more thrust to escape the planet's gravity well.

Players can ride rockets to different planets and rockets are the only way to get to orbiting space stations.
To be able to ride a rocket, the rocket must have a guidance computer with some destination programmed into it with a chip and a seat.
Once assembled and fueled, a player can right click on the rocket to ride it and press space to take off.
The Chemical Reaction is a multiblock used to turn Oxygen and Hydrogen into Rocket Fuel at the cost of RF.

The gravity controller is a machine that can be used to manipulate gravity within a certain radius in exchange for energy. The gravity controller can also affect the direction of gravity. When activated it does have a warmup and cooldown time so effects are not immediate.

The Oxygen Vent can be placed in an area that is sealed and when running, will fill the area with air. If the seal is broken then the air will immediatly escape out to the enviroment.
All sides of the Oxygen Vent must be either facing a sealed area, or against a solid block in order to properly function.
To run, the Oxygen Vent requires a source of power, a source of Oxygen, and a redstone signal. The need for Oxygen can be eliminated by placing CO2 Scrubbers with a Carbon Collection Cartridge on at least two sides of the Oxygen Vent.
The Oxygen Vent can only fill a square radius of 32 blocks.

When placed next to an Oxygen Vent, the CO2 scrubber reduces the amount of Oxygen required and increases the power consumption.

The Carbon Cartridge needs to be changed periodically (once every 24 hours of constant use if the server isn't lagging).

Due to the nature of difficult nature of working with a modular spacesuit, a Suit Workstation must be used to install, remove, and modify components built into the modular spacesuit.
To use the Suit Workstation a piece of the modular suit must be placed in the Armor holding slot. Once this is done the component slots will show what components are installed in the piece of armor.

Modular Space Suits not only protect players from the vacuum of space, but also offer various components that can be used to enhance the player in other ways.
The Space Suits themselves can be crafted in a crafting table, however components must be added to the suit in the Suit Workstation.

The Atmosphere Analyzer, if equipped in the spacesuit, a display in the lower left hand corner of the screen displaying current atmosphere and breathability will be shown.

The Anti-Fog Visor, if equipped in the spacesuit, it will allow you to easily see through the fog on high pressure planets.

The Bionic Legs, increases the player's running speed by 0.5 m/s per upgrade.

The Padded Landing Boots, eliminates fall damage.

The Super High Pressure Tank, Adds gas/liquid storage capacity for the suit, principally oxygen to breathe in space

The Jetpack, allows the player to fly in one of two modes(toggled by shift+toggle jetpack key) while consuming Hydrogen Gas during flight.

The warp controller is the control station block in a starship.
Simply placing the warp controller and warp core anywhere on a space station can turn it into a mobile starship capable of warping between planets and even solar systems.
The control panel offered by the warp controller allows a player to view their current location as well as select destinations as well as view fuel storage on the starship.

The ME Interface acts as an in between when working with pipes, tubes, networks, or machines from other mods.

You can configure certain items to be exported from the ME Network into the ME Interface for use with other mods. Or use other mods to insert into any ME Interface. as long as it isn't full of exported materials it will add any added items into the ME Network.

The extreme reactor will produce your energy with uranium or yellorium.
It is a multiblock structure.

can be used to speed the operation of the Crusher, Excavator, or Pumpjack by 25%.

The Bottling Machine is a 3x2x3 multi-block machine.

The Automated Workbench is a multiblock structure.
It works like the Engineer's Workbench but automatically !

The Metal Press is a 3x1x3 multi-block machine.
It's used to create Plates, Rods, gears and wires with the right Metal Press Mold.

The Crusher is a 3x5x3 multi-block machine. It's used for crushing Ores into Grit (Dusts).

When a mob or item is dropped into the center pit, the crushing process will start.
After a few seconds, the crushed items will be dropped out of the front-bottom-center.
If there is an inventory there (like a Chest), it will simply be placed into that inventory.

When a Mob is crushed, the Crusher will kill it, and output the corresponding drop/drops.

The Industrial Squeezer is a 3x3x3 multiblock machine.
It's used to make Plant Oil or HOP Graphite Dust.

The Fermenter is a 3x3x3 multiblock machine.
It is used to make Ethanol.

The Arc Furnace is a 5x5x5 Multiblock machine.
It is used to quickly smelt Ores, Grit and create Steel and other alloys, as well as to recycle tools and armor.

The top three slots in the GUI are for Graphite Electrodes. Each must be filled for the Arc Furnace to function.
Pipes (and similar) cannot access these slots, Graphite Electrodes have to be inserted manually

The Energy Condenser performs three functions.

1/ Any items placed in the inventory will be destroyed and converted to EMC which is then stored in the internal buffer.

2/ It receives EMC energy from an adjacent Energy Collector or Anti-Matter Relay.

3/ Using EMC energy from the internal buffer, it creates items of the type specified.

The GUI contains an energy bar, a single slot used to specify the item to produce, and a 91-slot inventory to hold the output.
As the Energy Condenser receives energy, the energy bar rises. When it reaches 100%, a single item of the type specified is created and placed in the inventory.

It can also be used in fuel cracking, Heavy fuesl can be cracked into lighter ones.
This means Diesel can be turned into Kerosene, Kerosene into Gasoline and Gasoline into LPG.

The Vortex Tube splits incoming air into hot and cold components.
One side will be heated (Red), the other cooled (Bleu). It's air usage is dependent on the pressure.
Mind that heat will slowly leak between the hot and cold sides, so it's more efficient to vent the cold side, with compressed Iron or/and Heat Sink, when you want to utilize the heat, and vice versa if you want to use the cold.
